newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firmer, sellers eyeing July futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firmer, sellers eyeing July futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices were slightly firmer in early trade on Tuesday with support for benchmark gas oil futures holding and sellers premiums marked up slightly to reflect the $1.50 June/July screen contango, traders said.
Traders said futures volatility kept buyers relaxed with little interest reported from the key German market.
"I have several buyers, they all want refinery product but they want it at least $1 under sellers levels," a broker said.
Offers of prompt lifting barges were pegged around $1.50 over June futures with very prompt bids at flat and bids for second half June around June IPE +50 cents fob Rotterdam.
Selling was also reported for early July barges at $1.50 over June futures fob Rotterdam. Traders said the slack buying had closed the refinery/storage spread to around $25 cents a gallon.
Early cargo talk was thin but here again sellers focused on slightly firmer July futures related pricing.
Balance of June Russian cargoes were valued around June IPE +$1 with FOD around June IPE +$2 and Diesel at June IPE +$5/+$6 a tonne cif NWE.
Support for gas oil futures was around $160 a tonne with the market up $1.50 at $161.50 around 1200 GMT.
The June/July spread valued around $1.50 in contango.
